newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares rise amid high market demand.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares rise amid high market demand.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market rose in an active week ending on Thursday, amid good liquidity and strong demand, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi 27-share index ended the week up at 2,384.56 from 2,377.12 points.
"Trading in the week registered its best performance for several months in the form of high levels of demand and supply ...and liquidity injected into the market...," said broker Zuhair Kaswani.
Shares of the new al-Khazna Insurance were steady at 350 dirhams, the price the shares had rallied to on the first week of trading. They had been issued late last month at 100 dirhams each.
Bank shares were in high demand, the brokers said.
National Bank of Abu Dhabi shares were up at 414 dirhams from 412, Union National Bank shares were up by five dirhams to 325 dirhams. National Bank of Dubai shares were steady at 665 dirhams.
Dubai Investment Comapny and telecommunications company Etisalat shares were steady at 15 dirhams and 945 dirhams respectively.
